title: Deterministic peak-extraction contract
provenance_caveat: Sampling-window matches are advisory and do not remove peaks.

records.exact_condition: For index i in 1..N-2: power[i] > power[i-1] and power[i] >= power[i+1].
records.deterministic_tie_break: Strict-left/non-strict-right resolves a flat two-point top to its left member.
records.notes: Boundary samples are not ordinary interior maxima.

records.exact_condition: Append frozen Stage 13.3 dominant_index when absent from ordinary local maxima.
records.deterministic_tie_break: Stage 13.3 dominant uses numpy.argmax, first grid occurrence on a tie.
records.notes: Guarantees the global Lomb–Scargle maximum enters the candidate set, including a boundary maximum.
Duplicate candidate indices are removed by sorted(set(indices)).

records.deterministic_tie_break: Lower frequency, then lower grid index.
records.notes: No peak-count cap and no power threshold are applied.

records.exact_condition: Process the frozen dominant candidate first, then all other candidates in candidate-rank order.
records.deterministic_tie_break: Candidate rank uses the deterministic ranking above.

records.exact_condition: Suppress candidate c when the first already retained r satisfies |f_c-f_r| < delta_f_R.
records.deterministic_tie_break: First close retained peak in traversal order is the suppressor.

records.notes: Retained rank is one-based traversal order.

records.exact_condition: The frozen global maximum is still appended and retained; execution fails only if dominant continuity or positive dominant power is invalid.
records.deterministic_tie_break: numpy.argmax first occurrence for dominant ties.
records.notes: At least one retained peak is therefore required for a successful observation.

records.exact_condition: Attach frozen FAP/level/significance to the dominant retained peak; secondary retained peaks receive NOT_EVALUATED and null FAP fields.
records.deterministic_tie_break: Dominant identity is frozen from Stage 13.3.
records.notes: FAP does not filter candidates or retained peaks.

records.exact_condition: Compare each retained peak with principal window peak and maximum sidelobe using distance <= delta_f_R.
records.deterministic_tie_break: Both reason codes may be retained in fixed order.
records.notes: Alias advisories never remove, rerank, or invalidate retained peaks.
